style.css:
@-moz-document domain("roblox.com"), domain("www.roblox.com") {
body,
  html,
  #app,
  .rbx-body,
  .container-main,
  .section,
  .content,
  .main-content,
  .game-page,
  .game-main-content,
  .profile-container,
  .home-container,
  .games-container,
  .games-list,
  .game-card-container,
  .game-card,
  .rbx-page-content,
  .rbx-main,
  .rbx-content,
  .rbx-body-content,
  .rbx-site-content,
  .rbx-dashboard-content,
  .rbx-profile-content {
    background-color: #17173a !important;
  }
}

@-moz-document domain("roblox.com"), domain("www.roblox.com") {
.rbx-navbar,
  .rbx-header,
  .rbx-footer,
  .rbx-tab,
  .tab-content,
  .rbx-left-col,
  .rbx-right-col,
  .rbx-game-feed,
  .rbx-game-server,
  .rbx-group-content,
  .rbx-friends-content {
    background-color: #17173a !important;
  }
}
